records.body:

Following up to see how things are going. If Wrenfield isn't the right fit, that's useful to know too -- either way I'd appreciate a reply.

records.subject: Anything I can help with?
records.body:
Hi Victor,

Hope the first few days with Wrenfield have been smooth. If you'd like, I can help you set up a first project so you're not starting from a blank page.

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Union Logistics
records.body:
Hi Victor,

Welcome to Wrenfield. There's no wrong way to start -- create a project, add a few tasks, invite people, and adjust as you figure out what works for your team.

Reply here if you need a hand.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Six days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone, zero tickets. Three Wrenfield outreaches (email:e5f44b11, email:4b81396c, email:f3ef92a6) went unanswered, including a direct fit-check. No customer-side signal of engagement; 8 days left makes unaided activation unlikely.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Victor,

I know you've heard from me a couple of times already, so I'll keep this short. Nothing has kicked off in Wrenfield yet, and I'd rather make the first step easy than keep nudging.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them -- so one project is usually all it takes to see how it fits your work at Union Logistics.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I can walk through creating that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Nadia
